Sleeping? Where?
Huh, the Infirmary?
Hm, they have one of those here?

Well, your dimwitted self WOULD
jump in bed as soon as you got here!
You never fail to be third rate.

Thanks for the concern. That I don't need.
I always go at it alone.
Games are best played solo.

Huh? A Servant?
You have Servant with you!?
I ask about #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's Servant, and…

I feel like that golden Servant isn't a "traditional" Servant,
but we pretty much made a contract.

#C236196003Shinji#CDEF's astonishment was closer to fear than confusion.
I ask about #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's Servant, and…
And the loser gets――

Hmph.
"When you lose, you die," right?

If we leave this structure and
go to some other area,
we'll reconnect in a flash. Definitely.

After all, the biggest contender―me―is here.
Management wouldn't abandon a star,
now would they?
Her?
Who?
Sakura?

By "her" I mean HER, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!
The drain-lady who made a complete fool
outta me!
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF asks me for battle data on #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.

…oh, yeah.
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF wasn't there when #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF attacked us.

I speak about her basic stats,
as well as the special skills she had used――
"Drain" and "#C000246204Invincibility#CDEF."

Eh? You weren't attacked this time?
She's straight up snubbing you!
You don't even qualify as an enemy to her!

But still――
You'll go back to the Near Side?
I should――
I still have to stop BB.
Most likely――
#C236196003Rin#CDEF, #C236196003Rani#CDEF, #C236196003Jinako#CDEF―― Everyone is worried.

Don't go into the Labyrinth anymore!
If you piss off #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF,
she'll come down on us, too!

We're down to four people…
If you disappear, too…
What the hell will we do…?
That's what #C236196003BB#CDEF kept warning us to do.

Damn, they even went as far as
shutting the blinds.
That #C236196003Leo#CDEF, what're you tryin' to hide?
I guess I'll try calling out to him.
Good morning～!

Whaddafu――!? D-damn, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF!
Wh-why are you……!
Nope.
"Nope"!?
…………woah.
So he is interested, after all.
This locker has cleaning supplies in it.

This locker is lent to the students.
I #[too][also]# put textbooks and dictionaries I'm not using here.

As I took my seat and started to relax,
my friend #C236196003Shinji Matou#CDEF came over to talk to me.

Ohh, let me guess.
Hooked on Piece Journal?

Oho. Always hacking and slashing
across the net, huh, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF?
――――Heh.

Oh well. If I can't remember,
then it must not have been that big of a deal.
Yeah, I have.

"Compete now, ye Wizards.
 #C000246204The Holy Grail#CDEF shall grant
 the final victor any wish they desire――"
#C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF――?
Where have I…… heard that before――

For instance, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF,
what would you wish for?

When they say "ANY wish,"
it feels like it has the nuance of being
"something you could never get on your own."

I can't really think of any huge "wish"
I could have right now.

How about you, #C236196003Leo#CDEF?
Got a wish that would surprise everyone?

I suppose so.
It seems I was mistaken.
#C236196003Julius#CDEF is #C236196003Leo#CDEF's older brother.
Say that AFTER you're No.1.

I see. To do that, you'll have to defeat
the European champion, don't you?
The European champion, No.1 in total score……

It's true that I'm No.2 right now.
But just you wait. In the next campaign,
I'll definitely beat them.
While we were talking idly, the bell for homeroom rang.
The teacher in charge of our class is a noisy one.

She must be in her twenties.
With a gentle gaze and a graceful stance,
she exudes a womanly charm
in spite of her rigid nun's uniform.

Her movements were as fluid as the wind
and conveyed straight away how earnest she was.

My name is #C236196003Taiga Fujimura#CDEF.
I will be teaching at this school
from today onward.
――――Sweet.
But――
Oh? Is that #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF sitting in the back?
Wh-what the!?
L-lovers……!?
……I scrunch my brows and sigh.
#C236196003Leo Bistario Harwey#CDEF.

At first, I was scared of how different we were
in upbringing and ability,
but now we casually talk just like this.

Could it really be that she thinks
she "has no more secrets"?

But, no program is perfect. Even if each
individual part is perfect, when two parts
collide, the reaction can breed flaws.

If you can agitate, or even make #C236196003Rani#CDEF excited,
you might be able to get a glimpse of her #C000246204SG#CDEF.

…the hell are you―― Don't talk to me!
Unlike you, I'm busy, see?

Did you know? Conflict only breaks out
between those of equal levels.
Kid bait only baits kids.

Thaaat aside…
Why do you know about Darling's problems?
Did you eavesdrop in so-me-whe-re, hmmm?

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF doesn't know much about real,
interpersonal relationships. Do you, #C236196003Karna#CDEF?

#C236196003Rani#CDEF's final secret… Hmm.
It's difficult to say, since I've never met
#C236196003Rani#CDEF… What's your take, #C236196003Andersen#CDEF?

…are you serious? A harpy like you should
be able to smell a fragrant girl's pretension
all the way from the Labyrinth.

…I don't understand what you mean, but…
have you completely figured out #C236196003Rani#CDEF's secret?

Yes. Thus, I can't give advice. Giving a girl's
secret to outsiders is the height of stupidity.
Like praising flowers while you pluck them.

Or what, #C236196003Kiara#CDEF?
Are you telling me to become an honest writer,
putting the plain truth down with my pen?

…*sigh*. You really are a pain to deal with.
I apologize, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.
Please seek help from someone else.

Heh…
Looks like you need my help, eh?

Hmm. Let's take a break in My Room for now,
Darling～

#C236196003Tamamo#CDEF's brain is wiped out from
thinking too much. Let's have ourselves
something sugary, real sugary鷙

Ehhh. #C236196003Shinji#CDEF, beating THAT human computer?
…maybe I shouldn't say so.
He seems pretty determined.

Divinations sometimes come true, and sometimes
don't. Anyway, we won't know unless we try.
"Kelp," was your name, yes?

King? Well, sure I guess. I AM the Game Champ.
I practically sweat auras!

Dang, he looks so cool…
Ah, uh, not that he could beat my #C236196003Rider#CDEF!
…as long as she's not hammered.

Yeah, I was chosen…
There's no way I'd lose in the 1st Round――
Huh? O-Oh, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.

O-ohh……
Y…… yeah, well,
I knew that stuff already!
Ahh, man. #C236196003Jinako#CDEF turned out to be hopeless.

Since we've competed over the net,
I expected her to be no ordinary player.
But look! She's just a damn NEET!
Huh…? Back already, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF?
#C236196003Rani#CDEF's Labyrinth is tougher than #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF's?
#C236196003Sakura#CDEF…? Nah, no relation.

…hmph. I hate to say it, but #C236196003Rani#CDEF won.
I AM a gamer.
We accept it when we lose in the game.

Good. Since I'M the one
who's going to beat her at chess, see?

Eh? The chess games are over?
#C236196003Rani#CDEF went into the Relief?

Wh-what's going on!?
Just who beat her in chess!?

Ahh, my head is still spinning…
Why was only MY camera spinning around
and around!?

#C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF and #C236196003Rani#CDEF still had human weaknesses,
but those #C000246204Alter Egos#CDEF,
err, they're no joke, you know…

Heh. I was worried for a second there,
but #C000246204Alter Egos#CDEF are no big deal.
Even you could take 'em on, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF!

Huh? It's an #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF?
You've been going up against THAT!?

Catching an #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF, huh?
…well, I won't be doing anything about it.

#C236196003J#CDEF-#C236196003Jinako#CDEF is missing?
What did you do, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF!?

You left her alone there and came back
on your own? Did you just up and run away…!?

N-no… That can't be it.
…sorry, my bad.
No point in blaming you, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.

………! #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF!
You, if it weren't for you…!

…no, that's not it.
That's not it…! DAMN IT!

Shut up! Don't talk to me!
Leave me alone!
……so #C236196003Jinako#CDEF's the Sentinel this time around…

So this was how she felt, huh?
I… get how she feels now.
Ultimately, #C236196003Jinako#CDEF had no place to go back to.

So, #C236196003Gatou#CDEF faced off against #C236196003Jinako#CDEF, huh?
I had to face…
Come on, leave me alone!
#C236196003Gatou#CDEF… is dead…?

Haha… hahahahahaha…
That dumbass…
And he even had a tiny shred of hope left…

So how about we just surrender to #C236196003BB#CDEF?
Sooner rather than later.
She'll spare us, won't she?

…oh, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.
Haha, you must think I'm a hopeless case,
too, right?

Sympathy is only going to make me
more miserable! #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF, you――
every one of you is looking down on me…!

……what, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF?
Is there something on my face?

You got somethin' you need to do
over there, too? Then don't worry about me
and get to it.
What is it? I'm about to leave.
Happens to everyone, right?

When I try to remember, my head starts to pound
like it got hit with a hammer……
I have to remember, or else……

That last development was amazing.
I wouldn't have expected such a twist to happen.
Huh?
Huh?
Huh?
Huh?

This is my assigned seat.
The top of it is a little bit chipped,
so I can tell right away if it's moved.

This is where #C236196003Shinji#CDEF sits.
There's nothing in his desk.
Essentially, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's desk is neatly organized.

It's a desk that reflects
the obsessive-compulsive #C236196003Shinji#CDEF well.

This is the desk assigned to #C236196003Leo#CDEF.
The desk is the same as everyone else's,
but the rest of the stationary he uses
are probably luxury goods.
The blackboard has been thoroughly cleared.
Someone's hiding under the desk……!
……yeah, like that would happen.

Wha―― That you, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF!?
Oh thank God, finally someone who gets
what I'm talking about!
As soon as he sees me, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's face starts to glow.

He's barely said anything yet,
but just from his gestures I could tell that he's the
same #C236196003Shinji Matou#CDEF I saw in the "previous school building."

Even if that "previous school building" was a dream I had,
the actors in that dream were projections of those
that had I met in the "real preliminaries."

It's safe to say that this #C236196003Shinji#CDEF has
the same personality as I remember.

So, same thing for you? When you came to,
you found yourself in this school building?
Hey, have you seen any sort of exit?
I answer #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's question with a shake of my head.

I explained that I had just woken up in this
old school building, so I had yet to see an exit.
Shinji talks the same way he usually does.

I know he's saying rude things,
but I don't feel any animosity towards him.

It looks like I've gotten TOO used to his
elitism and self-consciousness from my dream.
…also, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF really IS brilliant, despite how he looks.

Just like #C236196003Leo#CDEF asked of me,
let's try scouting him for the Student Council.

Huh? Student Council?
Team up and work together so we can
escape from here?

Ha! No way! A Student Council isn't worth
a damn. If everyone wants to get all chummy
to escape, then go right on ahead.

I'm a genius, you know.
I don't work with commoners.
I won't ask for anyone's help, either.

More importantly, this is the first I've
heard of #C236196003Leo#CDEF being here! I despise that guy.
So smug. All cool and calm.

If #C236196003Leo#CDEF got the boot and I'd be made President,
I'd consider it. Until then,
don't come to me for anything, okay?
…he ended up rejecting me.

But just what does #C236196003Shinji#CDEF
think he's going to do all on his own?

I know he's not great at making friends,
but I don't think it's smart to act tough
in a situation like this…

Let's put that aside. #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF,
do you remember the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF?
I answer by saying that I can't recall anything.

I feel like I made it through several rounds with my Servant,
but so long as I don't know "who" or "how" I fought,
I have nothing to tell #C236196003Shinji#CDEF.

The only real feeling I have left
is the firm bond I have with #C236196003#SVT#CDEF.
I answer by saying that I can't recall anything.

I feel like I made it through several rounds with my Servant,
but so long as I don't know "who" or "how" I fought,
I have nothing to tell #C236196003Shinji#CDEF.

Obviously, being a Master and all, I reply.
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF's astonishment was closer to fear than confusion.
…yeah, sort of, I answer with little confidence.

…gone. Apparently, we got separated
on the way here. Well, once I return to the
#C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF, she'll come back to me.

…that's right, I need to hurry up and get back
to the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF.#RUBS         I'm#RUBE Her Master's#REND not there.
That woman must be lonely in some dumb way…

Besides, I'm sure the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF's still on.
If you're not on the final battlefield in
seven days, you lose by default, right?

A #C000246204seven day period#CDEF…
A #C000246204final battlefield#CDEF… 
A #C000246204loss by absence#CDEF…
When I heard that, I remembered it too.

The #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF is a tournament with seven rounds.
First, an opponent is decided for you.
After seven days of preparation,
you go to the final battlefield and fight the enemy Master.
Those are the rules.

Naturally, losing this fight means elimination.
Not reaching the final battlefield is also "defeat."

Ridiculous. Worst comes to worst,
all you have to do is log out.
It's an old scare tactic.

Sure, that could be how the final selection
of the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF is.
Worst comes to worst, you can just drop your connection
and return to your body on Earth.

…however, they say that not a single #ROFS0001#RUBS  Magus#RUBE#C000246204Wizard#CDEF#REND who
went up to the Moon has ever returned from that cyberspace.

And――The real problem is that we're
in this school building, unable to get out.

W-what's with that gloomy look on your face!?
There's probably just no connection
between here and the surface.

What? The #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF is a Brain of God, right?
Then it'll help us soon enough.

You're so damn persistent.
A friendly little Student Council isn't
my thing. Can't you bother someone else?

…like I thought,
it sounds like #C236196003Shinji#CDEF has no intention of joining either.

I'm sure I've already looked around the
school building from top to bottom,
but I haven't gotten very good responses.
Let's stop by the Student Council Room to report to #C236196003Leo#CDEF.

First, we visit the Student Council.
If we all come up with another plan,
a way to beat #C236196003Rani#CDEF may arise.

Or rather, we'll find a way.
Though it's only chess, losing over and over
goes against every fiber of my being!

About our issue with #C236196003Rani#CDEF: what if we challenge
her to a game other than chess? I'm confident
that I'm second to none in Hanafuda…

Did we have games with pieces back in
ancient Uruk, you ask? The answer is obvious.

All of humanity's intellectual property, from
all origins, come from my stores. That #C236196003King of
Conquerors#CDEF' library only imitates mine.

Heeeeeeeey!
It SURE DOES look like my time to shine, huh!?

Ah! #C236196003Shinji#CDEF…!?
Where did you come from…!?

I was here the whole time!
Do you know how many minutes
I've been waiting here!?

#C236196003Shinji#CDEF, you… were waiting for me,
#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF?

Why on Earth―― Well, that's what I would say,
but it's not really that strange.
Maybe he was spying on the Student Council again.

Hmph――! I heard about it from #C236196003Sakura#CDEF.
#C236196003Rani#CDEF? Chess? How no one could beat her?

Hmph――! I heard about it from #C236196003Sakura#CDEF.
#C236196003Rani#CDEF? Chess? How no one could beat her?
Ah, except for #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF.

I don't feel like joining in on your
pointless floundering, but I can't just
ignore a classmate in trouble, you know?

It won't hurt to show off what this
No. 1 Game Champ of Asia is made of.
I'll lend you a hand, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.

Oh my. I sense an indescribable vigor from this
man… Listen, Praetor. Could this be the first
time he's been useful in his entire life?

…I won't give him points for eavesdropping,
but it's good that he volunteered to cooperate.
Let's see what he's got, I suppose.

――――Hm.
Though minuscule, I felt #ROFS0001#RUBSkingliness#RUBEan aura#REND……
Could this "#C236196003Shinji#CDEF" be the King of Buffoons?

Hmph. As usual, your Servant always
has something to say. Just you wait and see―
this time I'll show you how awesome I am…

…hey, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.
Have your Servant and I
ever spoken to each other before?

Hey now, that Servant of yours
has a real sharp set of eyes on him!
He's all golden and looks tough…

…whatever. Anyway, go on over to #C236196003Rani#CDEF.
I'll be on standby in
the Student Council Room, got it!?
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF is full of energy.

Let's trust in the Game Champ's skills
and try challenging #C236196003Rani#CDEF once again.

#C236196003Shinji#CDEF is standing in front of the room.
By the looks of it,
it seems he wants to talk to me about something.

Ever since the whole affair with #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF,
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF has become increasingly obstinate.

I wonder what #C236196003Shinji#CDEF wants to talk to me about,
in spite of that.

#C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF's been keeping me in the loop.
You saw just how outclassed you are,
yet you still went into HER Labyrinth, huh?

Not only did she treat me like a worm,
she even went and nano-sized me…!

If you had left me there, I'd be
liquid nutrients for that #ROFS0002#RUBSSakura#RUBE#C236196003AI#CDEF#REND right about now.
Thinking about it makes me shudder.

…so, how'd it go?
You entered her Labyrinth, so you fought her,
right? Show me your battle logs.

He doesn't know about #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's
fighting style or her #C000246204invincibility#CDEF skill.

How about we show him our previous data?
This man is a rather persistent one.
He'll keep asking and asking.

Please show him our last battle records.
We might even get… probably nothing out of it,
considering it's this guy.

*sigh* We haven't a single grain of obligation
to tell you anything, but having you follow us
around is SO annoying… Go ahead, Darling.

It would clearly be in vain to do so, but
there's always a possibility. If all he desires
is the battle data, then give it to him.

Urged on by #C236196003#SVT#CDEF,
I share my impressions of the time we were assaulted.

Huh…?
I knew about Drain, but what's up with that
"#C000246204Invincibility#CDEF"? Is she really invincible?

I can at least say that she nullified
everything we threw at her.

Maybe she just has high defense,
and if we get our attack stat up, we can break through…

…all we can do is hope that's the case
and head to the Labyrinth.

You've got some guts heading into
the Labyrinth with her after you…

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF and #C236196003BB#CDEF both have awful personalities,
but SHE'S even worse than awful. You'll get
slaughtered without mercy if she finds you…

And you're going to beat THAT?
Did #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF and the others come up
with some sort of strategy?
They're coming up with one.

But the hole #C236196003Leo#CDEF left behind is a big one.
All the work keeps piling up solely on #C236196003Rin#CDEF and #C236196003Rani#CDEF.

I have no choice but to find a countermeasure
for #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF within the Labyrinth.

…unbelievable.
Are you seriously not scared? You do realize
we have no chance of winning, right?

Yet you're still going to defy #C236196003BB#CDEF?
…the Near Side of the Moon
ain't that great a place, anyway.

The #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF was an actual slaughterfest.
Even if we make it back,
we'll either live or die. That's it.
I don't hear any of the usual bravado in #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's voice.

In his own way, he's speaking his mind.
He's expressing his raw apprehensions without any pretense.
I still have to get back to the Near Side.
…to be honest, I'm scared too…

…it's not that you want to go back,
it's that you have to…
What's the deal with you?

You're just #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.
When did you start walking around,
acting like a hero?

That stuff about the end of humanity?
It's a load of bull.
She's totally just talking it up.

#C236196003BB#CDEF is fundamentally the same as #C236196003Sakura#CDEF, right?
So it's fine. No way she's capable of
doing something that heinous.

That's right, you should be.
You're up against a monster out to dominate
the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF. No one can blame us.

You wouldn't be you otherwise, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF!
The fate of the world, protecting the Moon――
It's got nothing to do with us!
…looks like my answer didn't get through to #C236196003Shinji#CDEF.

No matter what I say,
there are no words that will make #C236196003Shinji#CDEF feel better.

That's something every person left in the
old school building has in common, not just #C236196003Shinji#CDEF.

The ones remaining are those who stifle such thoughts
and struggle on, and those who can no longer struggle on.

A-anyway, that's all I wanted to talk about.
I want nothing to do with all this pointless
floundering about you're all doing.

I just got―you know―a bone to pick with HER.
I was curious about what's been going on.
That's all this was, really!

…you heard me? DON'T.
If you value your life, then do nothing.
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF leaves, like he was holding back his frustration.

…don't go into the Labyrinth.
If we just stick to the old school building, we'll be safe…
…it's absurd to imagine, but:

maybe if we did as she said, our situation
wouldn't have changed, and no one would've disappeared.
